About COSBEL Ltd

COSBEL Ltd is an electrical engineering company based in Kimironko, Gasabo, Kigali. We design, install, manufacture and commission power-supply and power-distribution systems for factories and industrial sites, and we inspect existing electrical equipment such as transformers.

What that means in practice

From design to handover

Most of our clients are businesses: factories, warehouses and processing plants that depend on their power supply every day.

Design

We plan how a facility is supplied, including multi-source supplies with generator backup, breaker coordination and the operating modes for every failure scenario.

Installation

We install compact substations and transformers, lay underground cabling and integrate generators through transfer switches and interlocked changeovers.

Manufacturing

We design and manufacture our own manual ATS units, including installations that manage several generators.

Commissioning & inspection

We commission equipment such as industrial ovens with their own sub-distribution boards, inspect transformers and hand over with completion certificates and condition reports.

Common questions

Frequently asked questions

Short answers about where we work and what we do. For anything project-specific, call or send a quote request.

Where does COSBEL Ltd work?
We are based in Kimironko, Gasabo, Kigali and take on projects across Rwanda.
Do you work on homes as well as factories?
Yes. Our core work is industrial and commercial, but we also carry out residential electrical installation and maintenance.
Can you install a compact substation or transformer?
Yes. We supply and install compact substations and distribution transformers, including the high-voltage to low-voltage chain: ring main units, breakers, protection and metering.
Can you connect a generator to our existing supply?
Yes. We integrate generators through automatic transfer switches and interlocked changeovers, designed so that two sources are never connected together.
Do you manufacture ATS units?
We design and manufacture our own manual ATS units, including installations that manage several generators.
Can you inspect our transformer or electrical equipment?
Yes. We inspect existing equipment such as transformers and deliver formal condition reports.
Do you provide documentation when a job is finished?
Every project is handed over with completion certificates and inspection reports on COSBEL-branded documents.
How do we get a quote?
Call +250 788 312 434, email us, or send the request form on our contact page and we will come back to you.
